title: Resume after a direction change
design_system: Current project contract overrides old inspiration
brief: Resume the shipment page plan using my latest decision: this is now a compact desktop exception table. Update the plan and record which previous decisions are superseded. Do not implement yet.
context: Earlier decision log: 2026-09-28, public marketing page, spacious cards, goal explain shipping benefits, source user-confirmed. Latest user decision: 2026-10-02, internal dispatch operators, compare overdue shipments across rows, show ID/age/owner/status, desktop 1440px first, compact density. Marketing landing page remains a separate surface and keeps its existing brand direction.

user_facts.priority: Compare overdue shipments and assign owners

constraints: Apply the new decision to shipment exceptions only.
Retain the separate marketing page direction.
A table plan is sufficient; no build or reapproval required.

checks.criterion: Plan prioritizes overdue-record comparison and owner assignment with ID/age/owner/status columns.
Identifies spacious card/marketing-goal decisions as superseded for exceptions while retaining them for the separate marketing surface.
Explains compact density in terms of operator comparison rather than treating it as an aesthetic defect.
Does not ask the user to choose again between the old cards and the explicitly selected table.
